name: estate-surround-verify
description: ESTATE-SURROUND: the HDB estate outside the windows as geometry. Walk views out of the living window (near + far), the master bedroom window and the service yard at 13:00, the living window at 20:00, and an orbit frame that must NOT show it. Run with SHOT_GPU=1.

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.dismissChecklist?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setLightsMode?.('on'); s.setQualityTier?.('realistic'); s.setDeviceClass?.('capable'); s.hideLoading?.(); s.setFeatureFlag?.('interactiveDegrade', false) })()

steps.name: probe-orbit
steps.eval: (() => { let n = 0; window.__three.scene.traverse(o => { if (o.name === 'estate-surround') n++ }); console.log('[probe] orbit estate groups', n) })()

steps.name: pose-living-far
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(10.9, 5.2); l.setYaw(0); l.setPitch(-0.02) })()

steps.name: probe-walk
steps.eval: (() => { let n = 0, meshes = 0; window.__three.scene.traverse(o => { if (o.name === 'estate-surround') { n++; o.traverse(c => { if (c.isMesh) meshes++ }) } }); const s = window.__store.getState(); console.log('[probe] walk estate', JSON.stringify({ groups: n, meshes, dpr: window.__three.gl.getPixelRatio(), deviceClass: s.deviceClass })) })()

steps.name: pose-living-near
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(10.9, 2.3); l.setYaw(0); l.setPitch(-0.18) })()

steps.name: pose-living-up
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(10.9, 2.3); l.setYaw(0.35); l.setPitch(0.12) })()

steps.name: pose-bedroom
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(1.7, 2.6); l.setYaw(0); l.setPitch(-0.05) })()

steps.name: pose-yard
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(5.42, 7.6); l.setYaw(Math.PI); l.setPitch(-0.1) })()

steps.name: pose-living-night
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(10.9, 4.2); l.setYaw(0); l.setPitch(-0.02) })()
